query: Port of Brunswick vehicle tariffs import volume changes

statements.text: GPA saw a 7.5% decline in 2025 volume at the Port of Brunswick, its Roll-On/Roll-Off port for autos and heavy machinery.
Shipments of autos and machinery through the Port of Brunswick fell 14.3%. For the fiscal year to date, volumes have declined 11.8% to 132,918
The drop in volume was driven by tariffs that led to some manufacturers pausing shipments and a decline in exports to China, according to GPA.

With the introduction of US tariffs in 2025, automakers paused shipments, closed factories and held volumes at ports, leading to a year-on-year reduction in import and export volumes at the Port of Brunswick in Georgia.
